data.name: Burn Out
data.detailed_description:
Burn Out smashes through the doors of major corporations to make its grand entrance! Climb the corporate ladder to become the Boss by assembling a relentless team of coworkers in this local or online co‑op game for up to 4 players. But don’t let the pressure get to you, or you’ll end up in full Burn Out mode.

Paperwork everywhere and unbearable deadlines.

After failing in front of the big boss, you’ll have to work your way up and earn promotions until you eventually become the head of the company yourself.

MULTIPLAYER MADNESS, LOCAL OR ONLINE

Together (or with/against each other), collaborate to achieve the highest score in a chaotic multiplayer mode, either locally or online.

Explore each floor of your company’s skyscraper, packed with people and departments to discover, all as chaotic and hellish as the last. Experience new ways of working in this big corporate family, with dozens of different gameplay mechanics and a wide variety of levels to play!

MESS WITH YOUR FRIENDS!

Travel from floor to floor while smacking your friends to motivate them as much as possible. Sabotage your teammates to recreate that uniquely chaotic workplace atmosphere.

DON’T FALL INTO BURN OUT

Use your stress to complete tasks faster and move more quickly. But be careful—the more you rely on it, the more likely you are to snap and fall into Burn Out mode, where only time and a bit of rest will get you back into action.

data.short_description: Discover the world of Burn Out and all that the mega corporations can offer you in this splendid game in 4K, 120 fps. With more than 160 new levels, 20 different gameplay and with a free customization of your upper frame. Explore the chaotic and delirious world of Burn Out.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 470
